categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Hechuan Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in industrial automation, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of core industrial automation components and integrated solutions. Its main products include servo systems, programmable logic controllers (PLC), machine tools, chips, sensors, touch screens, frequency converters, industrial motors, direct drive motors, and precision linear guides and screws. The company serves diverse industries such as photovoltaics, lithium batteries, robotics, laser, 3C electronics, packaging, textiles, logistics, and woodworking.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including servo control, PLC control, motor control algorithms, high-precision encoders, image recognition sensors, and integrated industrial control chips. It employs a vertically integrated manufacturing process with in-house capabilities in die casting, CNC precision machining, electronic component assembly, and automated production lines. The company also uses ERP and MES systems to integrate production processes with automation equipment, achieving digital and automated manufacturing. R&D is structured around integrated product development (IPD) with multiple specialized centers and a matrix management model.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily in the new energy sector, including photovoltaics and lithium battery industries, as well as robotics, 3C electronics, laser processing, packaging, textiles, logistics, and machine tools. Major clients include industry leaders such as BYD, CATL, Foxconn Industrial Internet, SF Express, and Longi. The company focuses on large terminal customers and provides customized turnkey solutions for various industry segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Zhejiang Province and multiple subsidiaries across Chinese cities including Hangzhou, Suzhou, Dalian, and Quzhou. It also has international subsidiaries in Singapore and Germany. Overseas market expansion focuses on India, Turkey, Russia, and Southeast Asia, with participation in international exhibitions to enhance global brand presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hechuan Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the industrial automation supply chain. It develops and manufactures core control components such as servo systems and PLCs, and extends upstream into industrial control chips and sensors, while also engaging downstream with high-end precision machine tools and integrated automation solutions. The company maintains deep manufacturing capabilities and controls key production processes internally, with some outsourcing for non-core components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and product diversification, focusing on enhancing servo and PLC technologies while expanding into frequency converters, sensors, touch screens, industrial motors, direct drive motors, and precision transmission components. R&D efforts emphasize integrated control, drive, transmission, sensing, and digitalization. It invests heavily in R&D centers, patent development, and advanced testing facilities, pursuing industry-specific turnkey solutions and digital factory initiatives. Future R&D directions include AI integration, robotics components, and global market adaptation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of industrial automation products including servo systems, PLCs, machine tools, chips, and related components. The company employs a mixed sales model with a majority through distributors and a portion through direct sales to large strategic customers. Revenue recognition occurs at the point of product delivery and acceptance. The company also earns income from government subsidies and financial asset management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hechuan Technology is positioned as a leading domestic industrial automation company with competitive products that rival international brands such as Siemens, Yaskawa, Mitsubishi, and Omron. It holds a significant market share in China's servo system market, ranking second among domestic brands with about 4.4% market share in general servo systems. The company competes on technology, cost-effectiveness, and localized service, contributing to the growing trend of domestic substitution for imported products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 810.7 million, a 27.4% decline from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 165 million. Total assets stood at approximately RMB 1.97 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders at about RMB 1.38 billion. The company increased R&D investment to about RMB 160.9 million, representing 19.85% of revenue. Despite recent financial setbacks due to market conditions, the company maintains a strong asset base and continues to invest in growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hechuan Technology emphasizes high performance, reliability, cost-effectiveness, and industrial-grade design in its products. It offers a comprehensive product portfolio covering control, drive, execution, sensing, and mechatronics, enabling integrated automation solutions. The company’s proprietary technologies, such as high-precision encoders and integrated control chips, provide competitive advantages in precision, stability, and customization. Its deep manufacturing capabilities and localized customer service enhance responsiveness and product quality, supporting customers’ digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing needs.
